name: Doctrine of the Survivalist
body:
Subpages

You need to be able to rely upon yourself and be the example by which others can follow when it harsh and dangerous environs.

Nature Tell (Ex)

The wilds speak to you and let you know of their bounties and their dangers. By taking 1 minute to focus, you can learn one piece of information as if you had cast the commune with nature spell. This only works when in the terrain chosen with lead the hunt. Additionally, you may spend 1 point of faith to gain blindsense to a range of 30 feet for 1 minute.

Nature’s Bounty (Sp)

At 16th level, you can cast heroes’ feast by spending 3 points of faith. All allies who partake also gain the benefit of leading the hunt for the duration.
